reviews.review:
It's definitely an "ok" game, but the only reason you would pay the triple A pricetag for is the graphics. The game looks great. It is a fun game. I played the game only by myself and I racked up a large amount of playtime. But it has BIG issues.

1-MASSIVE pricetag. The base game having a triple A pricetag doesn't feel right. The only reason I see to purchase it at full price is the graphics. 
2-Unlikable characters. The whole cast of cleaners in the game are just ♥♥♥♥♥ and it isn't even funny. Having someone whine that they need to get picked up constantly as you are being swarmed just makes things more annoying. I don't need characters being all to be getting along, fights between characters can be natural and makes them feel human. But making them all ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ makes it much less fun for me. 
3-Difficulty scaling in chapters is completely unbalanced. Once I got to the higher difficulties like nightmare and no hope, I realized that the scaling of power in levels doesn't work at all. The first level is a gauntlet and the last few levels feel like a cakewalk. This issue has been resolved a small bit due to the introduction of bosses in the final levels but the first few levels difficulty hasn't been touched. You just finish the first 3 levels, then plow through everything. 

I did enjoyed the game a lot but the game has way too many issues that kind of killed my desire to play the game. There were some things I really enjoyed about it like the graphics and such but it's completely outweighed by all the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥. If you really want this game at least buy it on sale, it's definitely not worth the price.

Great zombie game, better with friends for sure. Many deck builds to choose and customize from. Certain builds make for some insanely good characters. Game has a challenge on the harder difficulties too. I wouldn't entirely compare this to L4D, but it is a nice successor. Too bad the devs shelved the game though.

Definitely a game that deserves more positive recognition. Graphics and gameplay are high quality and well executed. The game is difficult and has a lot of replay ability. People overlook it because the of Left for Dead but it's a really good game on it's own.

Put together some friends and return to the fun you used to have with L4D. The deck system lets you customize how you'll play to fit either the scenario or your mood, the maps have a fairly decent variety that'll require you to stretch your team to optimize your play throughs, and the difficulty scaling will take you from casual evening stroll to apocalyptic hell. Don't let the casuals crying about it being too hard scare you off, this is the game your group is looking for if you enjoy zombie shooters.
Underrated af game. Fun to grind. No micro-transactions. Free content. Perfect.
